This section explains how to start a local management session through the Console port on
the switch. This procedure requires a terminal, computer, or laptop with an RS-232 serial
port or USB port, and terminal emulator, such as PuTTy. It also requires a management
cable, as follows:
 If your computer has an RS-232 port, you may use the supplied management cable or
refer to Appendix A, Technical Specifications, in the IE340 Series Installation Guide for
cable wiring specifications.
 If your computer has a USB port, you may need to purchase a USB-to-Serial converter
that is compatible with its operating system. An example is the VT-Kit3 converter from
Allied Telesis.
